sentences.text: 小哥是外地人， 对这附近都不熟，还是李诗情想起来附近有个挺大的公园，这种郊外的公园监控会比较少，于是两人决定先去那儿藏一藏，再见招拆招。
sentences.translation: The young man is from out of town and is not familiar with this area. Li Shiqing remembered that there is a large park nearby. Such suburban parks usually have fewer surveillance cameras. So, the two decided to hide there first, then deal with the situation when it arises.
sentences.explanation: The sentence introduces a plan made by the characters to hide in a nearby park with fewer surveillance cameras before taking further action.

words.definition: deal with the situation when it arises
deal with the situation when it arises

content.raw_text: 因为小哥难得发了火, 李诗情这一路上就有点蔫蔫的, 没有再主动提起有关公交车的事情，脑子里却一直还在想着那辆车能不能得救的事儿。

sentences.text: 因为小哥难得发了火， 李诗情这一路上就有点蔫蔫的，没有再主动提起有关公交车事情，脑子里却一直还在想着那辆车能不能得救的事儿。
sentences.translation: Because the young man rarely got angry, Li Shiqing felt a bit down all the way, and did not bring up the matter of the bus again on her own, but her mind was always thinking about whether the bus could be saved.
sentences.explanation: This sentence describes Li Shiqing feeling a bit down after the young man got angry, and how she was thinking about whether the bus could be saved despite not bringing up the topic herself.

content.raw_text: 正如小哥所说, 大概由于她死了太多次，已经死的有些“麻木”了, 也渐渐习惯于这样的“循环”, 潜意识里已经觉得能不停“死而复生”是一种天经地义的事儿, 没有更深层次地思考过如果循环停止了该怎么办, 如果不能再循环怎么办。

sentences.text: 正如小哥所说， 大概由于她死了太多次，已经死的有些“麻木”了，也渐渐习惯于这样的“循环”，潜意识里已经觉得能不停“死而复生”是一种天经地义的事儿，没有更深层次地思考过如果循环停止了该怎么办，如果不能再循环怎么办。
sentences.translation: As the young man said, probably because she has died too many times, she has become somewhat 'numb' to death, and gradually accustomed to this 'cycle'. Subconsciously, she already feels that being able to constantly 'die and come back to life' is a natural thing, without giving deeper thought to what to do if the cycle stops, or what to do if she can no longer cycle.
sentences.explanation: The sentence describes the character's acceptance of a repetitive cycle of death and resurrection, without considering the consequences if the cycle were to stop or if she could no longer continue the cycle.

content.raw_text: 但是肖鹤云不同，肖鹤云还没循环几次, 而他循环的那几次, 还“李诗情”这个同伴互相依靠，那种眼睁睁看人去死和无论如何都无法结束的绝望并没有完全影响到他。

sentences.text: 但是肖鹤云不同，肖鹤云还没循环几次， 而他循环的那几次，还“李诗情”这个同伴互相依靠，那种眼睁睁看人去死和无论如何都无法结束的绝望并没有完全影响到他。
sentences.translation: However, Xiao Heyun is different. Xiao Heyun has not cycled a few times yet, and during his cycling, he and his companion 'Li Shiqing' relied on each other. The kind of despair of watching people die helplessly and unable to end it completely did not affect him.
sentences.explanation: The sentence describes how Xiao Heyun, unlike others, was not completely affected by the despair of watching people die helplessly and being unable to end it, even though he and his companion Li Shiqing relied on each other during their cycling experiences.

content.raw_text: 而他的性格, 决定了他比起“救下全车的人”，更倾向于“我自己挣脱这个循环”。

sentences.text: 而他的性格， 决定了他比起“救下全车的人”，更倾向于“我自己挣脱这个循环”。
sentences.translation: And his personality determines that he is more inclined to 'free myself from this cycle' than 'save all the people in the car'.
sentences.explanation: This sentence contrasts two choices or inclinations of the person based on his personality.

words.definition: all the people in the car

content.raw_text: 这种观念上的差异, 在两人终于在僻静的地方开始“聊聊”时, 表现的越发明显。

sentences.text: 这种观念上的差异， 在两人终于在僻静的地方开始“聊聊”时，表现的越发明显。
sentences.translation: This kind of difference in ideas became more apparent when the two finally started to "chat" in a secluded place.
sentences.explanation: The sentence describes how the differences in ideas between the two individuals became more evident when they finally had a chance to chat in a secluded place.

content.raw_text: “现在最好的局面，就是我们的循环停止了, 睡一觉起来就是明天。公交车出事也好，没出事也好，与我们无关。”

sentences.text: “现在最好的局面，就是我们的循环停止了， 睡一觉起来就是明天。
sentences.translation: The best situation now is that our cycle has stopped, sleep and wake up, it will be tomorrow.
sentences.explanation: The sentence describes a situation where the cycle has stopped, and the speaker can sleep peacefully, knowing that when they wake up, it will be a new day.

sentences.text: 公交车出事也好，没出事也好，与我们无关。
sentences.translation: Whether the bus has an accident or not, it has nothing to do with us.
sentences.explanation: The structure '也好，没出事也好' is a way to express 'whether... or not' in Chinese.
The sentence ends with a quotation mark and an ellipsis, indicating a continuation or omission of text.

content.raw_text: 小哥叹口气, 心累地说, “但如果是这样的话，我们迟早面对我们为什么会知道炸/弹在车上的质疑，毕竟我们不能永远关机，或者永远躲起来。”

sentences.text: 小哥叹口气， 心累地说，“但如果是这样的话，我们迟早面对我们为什么会知道炸/弹在车上的质疑，毕竟我们不能永远关机，或者永远躲起来。
sentences.translation: The young man sighed, tiredly saying, 'But if that's the case, sooner or later we will face the question of why we knew there was a bomb in the car. After all, we can't keep the phone off forever, or hide forever.'
sentences.explanation: The sentence discusses the inevitability of facing the question of why they knew about the bomb in the car, as they cannot keep avoiding the situation forever.
The sentence ends with a quotation mark and an ellipsis, indicating a continuation or omission of text.

content.raw_text: 闻言，李诗情下意识地辩驳：“但如果警方因为我的报警成功的破获了这起公交车爆炸案，就会弄清楚爆炸的原因、爆炸/物是什么，以及罪犯的身份。如果他们和上次一样选择全网通报的话，我们就能得到这些原因和线索……”

sentences.text: 闻言，李诗情下意识地辩驳：“但如果警方因为我的报警成功的破获了这起公交车爆炸案，就会弄清楚爆炸的原因，爆炸/物是什么，以及罪犯的身份。
sentences.translation: Upon hearing this, Li Shiqing subconsciously argued, "But if the police were able to solve this bus explosion case successfully because of my report, they would be able to figure out the cause of the explosion, what exploded, and the identity of the criminal."
sentences.explanation: The sentence showcases the use of conditional sentences and the possessive particle '的' to indicate possession or association.

sentences.text: 如果他们和上次一样选择全网通报的话，我们就能得到这些原因和线索…
sentences.translation: If they choose to report to the whole network like last time, we will be able to obtain these reasons and clues...
sentences.explanation: The structure 如果...的话 is used to express a conditional statement in Chinese. Also, the phrase 全网通报 means 'report to the whole network.'

sentences.translation: The sky was getting dark, and it was about to rain.
sentences.explanation: The sentence uses the structure '快...了' to indicate that something is about to happen.
The sentence ends with a closing quotation mark.

content.raw_text: “你说的这种可能，是最好的可能。先不提警方能不能尽快破获案件、会不会全网通报，你这件事变好事还得有一个前提……”

sentences.text: “你说的这种可能，是最好的可能。
sentences.translation: The possibility you mentioned is the best possibility.
sentences.explanation: The structure '是...的' is a common way to emphasize a specific quality or characteristic in Chinese.

sentences.text: 先不提警方能不能尽快破获案件，会不会全网通报，你这件事变好事还得有一个前提…
sentences.translation: Let's not talk about whether the police can solve the case quickly or if they will notify the whole internet, for your situation to turn into a good thing, there must be a premise...
sentences.explanation: The sentence contains conditional structures and idiomatic expressions that may be challenging for intermediate learners.

sentences.translation: Chapter 16 is the most exciting chapter in the book.
sentences.explanation: The tricky part here is the use of '的' as a possessive particle to indicate that the chapter belongs to the book.
The sentence ends with a closing quotation mark.

content.raw_text: 小哥苦笑着，“只有我们真的会重新循环，这些线索对我们才有用。”

sentences.text: 小哥苦笑着，“只有我们真的会重新循环，这些线索对我们才有用。
sentences.translation: The young man smiled bitterly, "Only when we truly recycle, these clues will be useful to us."
sentences.explanation: The sentence emphasizes the importance of truly recycling and hints at the significance of the clues for the characters.
The sentence ends with a closing quotation mark.

content.raw_text: 【但你愿意再进入循环吗？】

sentences.text: 【但你愿意再进入循环吗？
sentences.translation: But do you want to enter the loop again?
sentences.explanation: The sentence structure is a simple question asking if the listener wants to enter the loop again. The use of '吗' at the end turns the statement into a question.
This sentence only consists of a punctuation mark '】', which is used for formatting or emphasis in Chinese text.

content.raw_text: 这么残酷的话，他没说出来。

sentences.text: 这么残酷的话，他没说出来。
sentences.translation: He didn't say such cruel words.
sentences.explanation: The structure '这么...的话' is used to emphasize the cruelty of the words. The word '出来' is used to indicate speaking out or expressing something.

content.raw_text: 可李诗情一看他的表情，就懂了。

sentences.text: 可李诗情一看他的表情，就懂了。
sentences.translation: Li Shiqing understood just by looking at his expression.
sentences.explanation: The structure '一看...就...' indicates that something is understood immediately upon seeing a certain action or situation.

content.raw_text: 于是她越发沉默。

sentences.text: 于是她越发沉默。
sentences.translation: So she became even more silent.
sentences.explanation: The structure '越发' is used to indicate an intensification of the following adjective, similar to 'even more' in English.

content.raw_text: “还有一种可能，是警方没有破获案件，循环又继续了……”

sentences.text: “还有一种可能，是警方没有破获案件，循环又继续了…
sentences.translation: There is another possibility, that the police have not solved the case, and the cycle continues...
sentences.explanation: The sentence structure in Chinese allows for the verb 'continue' to be placed at the end of the sentence, which may differ from English sentence structure.

sentences.translation: Chapter 16 is the most exciting chapter in the book.
sentences.explanation: The tricky part here is the use of the possessive particle '的' to indicate that the chapter belongs to the book.
The sentence is missing, but it ends with a closing quotation mark.

content.raw_text: 小哥揉了揉被镜托压着的鼻梁，无力地说：“那我们从这一站下车，除了提心吊胆，一点意义都没有，这些时间等于被浪费了。”

sentences.text: 小哥揉了揉被镜托压着的鼻梁，无力地说：“那我们从这一站下车，除了提心吊胆，一点意义都没有，这些时间等于被浪费了。
sentences.translation: The young man rubbed his nose, which was pressed by the glasses frame, and weakly said, 'If we get off at this station, besides feeling anxious, it's all meaningless. This time is equivalent to being wasted.'
sentences.explanation: The sentence describes the young man expressing his frustration and disappointment about the situation they are in, emphasizing the feeling of wasting time.
The sentence ends with a closing quotation mark.

content.raw_text: “我以为你下车只是因为不想再被炸一次，再加上我也挺害怕那种濒死的感受，所以我选择下车报警，但这不代表我不想管这件事了。”

sentences.text: “我以为你下车只是因为不想再被炸一次，再加上我也挺害怕那种濒死的感受，所以我选择下车报警，但这不代表我不想管这件事了。
sentences.translation: I thought you got off the car just because you didn't want to be bombed again, plus I was quite scared of that near-death feeling, so I chose to get off the car and call the police, but that doesn't mean I don't want to deal with this matter.
sentences.explanation: The sentence contains complex structures like '再加上' (plus) and '不代表' (doesn't mean), which might be challenging for intermediate learners.
The sentence contains a quotation mark and an ellipsis, indicating that there is more text following this sentence.

content.raw_text: 李诗情直到这一刻，才发现了她和同伴之间真正的分歧：“如果我没报警的话，如果你不是想找线索，你下车准备做什么？”

sentences.text: 李诗情直到这一刻，才发现了她和同伴之间真正的分歧：“如果我没报警的话，如果你不是想找线索，你下车准备做什么？
sentences.translation: Li Shiqing didn't realize the true difference between her and her companions until this moment: 'If I didn't call the police, if you weren't looking for clues, what were you getting off the car to do?'
sentences.explanation: This sentence contains conditional clauses using '如果' (if), and the structure '如果...的话' is a common way to express 'if...'. The phrase '下车' (get off the car) is a compound word consisting of '下' (get off) and '车' (car).
The sentence contains a closing quotation mark and an ellipsis, which indicates an omission or pause in the text.

content.raw_text: “什么都不做。”

sentences.text: “什么都不做。
sentences.translation: Do nothing.
sentences.explanation: The structure '什么都不' is a common way to express 'nothing' or 'not anything' in Chinese.
The sentence ends with a quotation mark and an ellipsis, indicating a continuation or omission of text.

content.raw_text: 小哥耸了耸肩。

sentences.text: 小哥耸了耸肩。
sentences.translation: The young man shrugged.
sentences.explanation: The sentence structure is Subject + Verb + Object. The character '了' indicates the completion of the action.

content.raw_text: “我原本的计划，是想先下车，然后在被警方传唤后用‘到站下车’的正常理由搪塞过去。如果这件事过去了，以后又不循环了，这件事就跟我们没关系了。”

sentences.text: “我原本的计划，是想先下车，然后在被警方传唤后用‘到站下车’的正常理由搪塞过去。
sentences.translation: My original plan was to get off the bus first, and then come up with a normal excuse like 'getting off at the stop' to pass off when summoned by the police.
sentences.explanation: The sentence contains a complex structure with multiple verbs and clauses. Pay attention to the use of '被' as a passive marker and the phrase '搪塞过去' meaning 'to pass off/deceive'.

sentences.text: 如果这件事过去了，以后又不循环了，这件事就跟我们没关系了。
sentences.translation: If this matter is over and does not recur in the future, then it has nothing to do with us.
sentences.explanation: The structure '如果...，以后又不...了' indicates a conditional statement about a future action.
The sentence ends with a closing quotation mark and an ellipsis, indicating a continuation or omission of text.

content.raw_text: 他说，“我知道你可能觉得我太‘苟’了，但是你也看到了，车上有一个炸/弹和不知道有多少个的恐怖分子，这种事根本都不是我们这样的普通人能解决的。我们死了这么多次，也尽力了！”

sentences.text: 他说，“我知道你可能觉得我太‘苟’了，但是你也看到了，车上有一个炸/弹和不知道有多少个的恐怖分子，这种事根本都不是我们这样的普通人能解决的。
sentences.translation: He said, 'I know you may think I am too 'indifferent', but you also saw that there is a bomb and who knows how many terrorists on the car. This kind of thing is simply not something ordinary people like us can solve.'
sentences.explanation: The sentence contains a complex structure with embedded quotations and a comparison using '太...了' to express 'too...'. The word '苟' here is used to mean 'indifferent' or 'careless'.

sentences.text: 我们死了这么多次，也尽力了！
sentences.translation: We have died so many times, and also tried our best!
sentences.explanation: The structure '这么多次' means 'so many times' and '尽力了' means 'tried our best'. The use of '了' at the end of each verb indicates the completion of the actions.
The sentence ends with a closing quotation mark.

content.raw_text: “如果我们这一车人都注定是要死的，那我们逃出来有可能是老天开眼，也有可能是阎王爷打了个盹儿，无论是哪一种，人要珍惜机会，我们不是真凶，我们没必要为救不下所有人怀有负罪感……”

sentences.text: “如果我们这一车人都注定是要死的，那我们逃出来有可能是老天开眼，也有可能是阎王爷打了个盹儿，无论是哪一种，人要珍惜机会，我们不是真凶，我们没必要为救不下所有人怀有负罪感…
sentences.translation: If all of us in this car are destined to die, then our escape could be a stroke of luck, or perhaps the King of Hell took a nap. Regardless of the reason, we should cherish this opportunity. We are not the real culprits, so we don't need to feel guilty for not being able to save everyone...
sentences.explanation: The sentence discusses the possibility of escaping from a situation where everyone in a car is destined to die. It mentions the idea of luck, fate, and the guilt of not being able to save everyone.

words.definition: particle indicating past tense or completion

sentences.translation: This is the sentence to analyze: ...
sentences.explanation: The sentence introduces the text to be analyzed.
The sentence ends with a quotation mark and an ellipsis, indicating a continuation or omission of text.

content.raw_text: “可是我对你怀有负罪感。”

sentences.text: “可是我对你怀有负罪感。
sentences.translation: But I harbor guilt towards you.
sentences.explanation: The structure '对...怀有...' means 'harbor feelings towards...'. The term '负罪感' specifically refers to 'guilt'.
The sentence ends with a closing quotation mark.

content.raw_text: 李诗情突然开口，打断了他的侃侃而谈。

sentences.text: 李诗情突然开口，打断了他的侃侃而谈。
sentences.translation: Li Shiqing suddenly spoke, interrupting his eloquent speech.
sentences.explanation: The structure '打断了' indicates that the action of interrupting has been completed.

content.raw_text: “因为对你的负罪感，我甚至不敢再拉任何人下车。”

sentences.text: “因为对你的负罪感，我甚至不敢再拉任何人下车。
sentences.translation: Because of my guilt towards you, I dare not pull anyone off the car anymore.
sentences.explanation: The structure '因为...，我甚至不敢...' indicates a cause-and-effect relationship, emphasizing the speaker's reluctance due to guilt.
The sentence ends with a quotation mark followed by an ellipsis, indicating a continuation or omission of text.

content.raw_text: 小哥脸上原本满不在乎的表情一顿。

sentences.text: 小哥脸上原本满不在乎的表情一顿。
sentences.translation: The young man's indifferent expression suddenly changed.
sentences.explanation: The sentence structure in Chinese places the time adverbial '一顿' (suddenly) at the end of the sentence, which may be different from English sentence structures.

content.raw_text: 湿地公园里，安静到连虫鸣鸟叫都听的清清楚楚。

sentences.text: 湿地公园里，安静到连虫鸣鸟叫都听的清清楚楚。
sentences.translation: In the wetland park, it is so quiet that even the sounds of insects and birds can be heard clearly.
sentences.explanation: The structure '安静到连...都...' emphasizes the extent of quietness, indicating that even the sounds of insects and birds can be heard clearly.

sentences.text: 一群掠空而过的飞鸟穿过他们的头顶，从高空中送来微弱的鸣声，天高云阔，衬得女孩越发娇小，可她的声音，却又是那么清晰有力。
sentences.translation: A group of flying birds passing overhead, bringing faint chirping from the high sky, the vast sky making the girl appear even smaller, yet her voice is so clear and powerful.
sentences.explanation: This sentence contains descriptive language about the scene, using adjectives and verbs to paint a vivid picture of the girl and the birds flying overhead.

sentences.text: “虽然你从来没埋怨过我，可我却一直在内疚。
sentences.translation: Although you have never complained about me, I have always felt guilty.
sentences.explanation: The structure '虽然...可...' is used to express a contrast or contradiction in this sentence. The word '从来' emphasizes the idea of 'never' in a negative context. The term '内疚' means 'guilty' in this context.

sentences.text: ”她说，“我为了逃开那个令人窒息的地方把你不管不顾地拉了下去，虽然你说我在某种意义上救了你的命，而我当时也是这么想的，可已经十几次了，我知道…
sentences.translation: She said, 'I dragged you down without caring about you in order to escape that suffocating place. Although you said I saved your life in a sense, and I also thought so at the time, it has been more than ten times, I know...
sentences.explanation: The sentence contains complex grammar structures such as the use of particles like '的' to indicate possession and '了' to show completion of an action. The phrase '不管不顾' is an idiomatic expression meaning 'without caring about.'

sentences.translation: The young man looked at the girl and couldn't speak for a long time.
sentences.explanation: The structure '半天开不了口' is a common Chinese expression to indicate someone is unable to speak or hesitant to speak for a long time.

words.definition: half a day, a long time

content.raw_text: “是我把你带进这个地狱的。你说这一车人的命也许都和我没有关系，可从我进入循环开始，这一切已经跟我有关了。”

sentences.text: “是我把你带进这个地狱的。
sentences.translation: It was me who brought you into this hell.
sentences.explanation: The structure '把...带进' is a common Chinese grammar pattern used to indicate the action of bringing someone/something into a place.

words.definition: particle marking the object of a verb

sentences.text: 你说这一车人的命也许都和我没有关系，可从进入循环开始一切已经跟我有关了。
sentences.translation: You said maybe the lives of all the people in this car have nothing to do with me, but since I entered the loop, everything is already related to me.
sentences.explanation: The sentence uses the structure '从...开始' to indicate 'since' or 'from the point of'. The phrase '跟我有关' means 'related to me'.
The sentence ends with a closing quotation mark.

content.raw_text: 她依然用一种“强势”的态度撑着自己，就如同无数次濒临崩溃又重振精神时那样。

sentences.text: 她依然用一种“强势”的态度撑着自己，就如同无数次濒临崩溃又重振精神时那样。
sentences.translation: She still supports herself with a 'dominant' attitude, just like the countless times when she was on the brink of collapse and then rallied her spirits.
sentences.explanation: The sentence describes how the woman maintains a strong attitude despite facing challenges, drawing on past experiences of overcoming difficulties.

content.raw_text: 李诗情的眼前闪过急诊科里那些痛苦哀嚎的人，闪过他们被推进急救室的那一幕。

sentences.text: 李诗情的眼前闪过急诊科里那些痛苦哀嚎的人，闪过他们被推进急救室的那一幕。
sentences.translation: Li Shiqing's mind flashed with the painful cries of the emergency room, flashed with the scene of them being pushed into the emergency room.
sentences.explanation: This sentence describes a scene where the character Li Shiqing recalls the painful cries of people in the emergency room and the moment they were pushed into the emergency room.

content.raw_text: 她看着小哥，看着他脸上的每一个细节，似乎想用这种方式把他记住。

sentences.text: 她看着小哥，看着他脸上的每一个细节，似乎想用这种方式把他记住。
sentences.translation: She looked at the young man, looking at every detail on his face, as if trying to remember him in this way.
sentences.explanation: The structure '把...记住' is a common way in Chinese to express 'remembering someone/something'.

words.definition: marking the object of a verb

content.raw_text: “我做不到眼睁睁看着那么多人死，然后一直活在悔恨里。我逃避过，事实证明，我不行。”

sentences.text: “我做不到眼睁睁看着那么多人死，然后一直活在悔恨里。
sentences.translation: I can't just watch so many people die and then live in regret.
sentences.explanation: The structure '做不到' means 'can't do' in this context. The phrase '眼睁睁' emphasizes helplessly watching something happen.

sentences.text: 我逃避过，事实证明，我不行。
sentences.translation: I have escaped, and the fact proves that I cannot do it.
sentences.explanation: The structure '逃避过' indicates that the action of escaping has been experienced in the past. '不行' is a colloquial way to say 'cannot do it' or 'not capable'.
The sentence contains a quotation mark and an ellipsis, indicating that there is more text following this sentence.

content.raw_text: 被人用这样的方式看着，耳边响着这样的话，小哥的一切抱怨都卡了壳。

sentences.text: 被人用这样的方式看着，耳边响着这样的话，小哥的一切抱怨都卡了壳。
sentences.translation: Being looked at in this way, hearing these words in his ears, all of Xiao Ge's complaints got stuck.
sentences.explanation: The structure '被...看着' indicates passive voice, where the subject is being looked at by someone. The phrase '卡了壳' is an idiomatic expression meaning 'got stuck'.

content.raw_text: “你说的一切我都明白，你所有过的期盼我全期盼过，你试想过的可能我全都试想过，你下站回归正常生活的尝试，我也尝试过。那个我拽着你下车的时刻，我也曾你一样，想着也许这就是最后一次，但事实证明，老天爷就是不肯放过我。”

sentences.text: “你说的一切我都明白，你所有过的期盼我全期盼过，你试想过的可能我全都试想过，你下站回归正常生活的尝试，我也尝试过。
sentences.translation: I understand everything you said, I have hoped for everything you have hoped for, I have considered all the possibilities you have considered, I have also attempted to return to a normal life at the next stop.
sentences.explanation: The sentence showcases the use of possessive particles 的 to indicate possession or association. It also demonstrates the repetition of verbs to express the completion of actions in different contexts.

sentences.text: 那个我拽着你下车的时刻，我也曾你一样，想着也许这就是最后一次，但事实证明，老天爷就是不肯放过我。
sentences.translation: At that moment when I dragged you out of the car, I also, like you, thought maybe this was the last time, but as it turned out, God was unwilling to let me go.
sentences.explanation: The sentence reflects the speaker's contemplation of a possible final moment, but ultimately, fate had other plans.
The sentence ends with a closing quotation mark.

content.raw_text: 她的眼睛里慢慢沁出一眶眼泪，眶满后，泪水便沿着她的面颊流了下来，静静的划过下巴，落到了地上。

sentences.text: 她的眼睛里慢慢沁出一眶眼泪，眶满后，泪水便沿着她的面颊流了下来，静静的划过下巴，落到了地上。
sentences.translation: Tears slowly welled up in her eyes, filled her eye sockets, then flowed down her cheeks, silently tracing her jawline and falling to the ground.
sentences.explanation: This sentence describes the process of tears welling up in someone's eyes, filling the eye sockets, flowing down the cheeks, and falling to the ground. Pay attention to the use of descriptive words and the flow of the tears in this emotional scene.

content.raw_text: “我知道不停轮回是什么样子，也知道孤军一人奋斗又看不到结果有多绝望。我比你多‘死’过五次。如果循环有次数，我可能比你先消失，所以我得在我消失前，尝试更多的可能。”

sentences.text: “我知道不停轮回是什么样子，也知道孤军一人奋斗又看不到结果有多绝望。
sentences.translation: I know what it's like to be in an endless cycle, and how desperate it is to fight alone without seeing any results.
sentences.explanation: The sentence describes the speaker's understanding of the feelings of being stuck in a repetitive cycle and the despair of fighting alone without seeing any outcomes.

sentences.text: 我比你多‘死’过五次。
sentences.translation: I have 'died' more than you five times.
sentences.explanation: The structure '比...多' is used to express 'more than' in this context. The use of '过' after a verb indicates experience in the past.

sentences.text: 如果循环有次数，我可能比你先消失，所以我得在我消失前，尝试更多的可能。
sentences.translation: If the loop has a number of times, I may disappear before you, so I have to try more possibilities before I disappear.
sentences.explanation: The sentence uses conditional structure '如果...，我可能...，所以...' (If...I may...so...). The word '得' is used to indicate necessity.
The sentence ends with a closing quotation mark.

content.raw_text: “我知道你很害怕，你什么都不想管了……”她哽咽着，却努力想露出笑容，“我，我都明白的。”

sentences.text: “我知道你很害怕，你什么都不想管了…
sentences.translation: I know you are very scared, you don't want to deal with anything...
sentences.explanation: The structure '什么都不' is used to express 'not...anything' in Chinese.

words.definition: indicating a change of situation or state

sentences.translation: Chapter 16 is the last chapter of this book.
sentences.explanation: The structure '第 + number + 章' is commonly used to refer to chapters in a book in Chinese.

sentences.text: ”她哽咽着，却努力想露出笑容，“我，我都明白的。
sentences.translation: She choked up, but tried hard to show a smile, 'I, I understand it all.'
sentences.explanation: The structure '我，我都明白的' emphasizes the speaker's understanding by repeating 'I' and adding '都' (all) before the verb '明白' (understand).
The sentence ends with a closing quotation mark.

content.raw_text: 肖鹤云扭头看她，脸上浮现一丝羞愧。

sentences.text: 肖鹤云扭头看她，脸上浮现一丝羞愧。
sentences.translation: Xiao Heyun turned his head to look at her, a hint of embarrassment appearing on his face.
sentences.explanation: The structure '一丝' is used to indicate a small amount or a hint of something, in this case, a hint of embarrassment.

content.raw_text: 他知道，无论他分析的多么透彻，说得多么冠冕堂皇，那仿佛成年人看孩子一样高高在上的态度，其实都只是为了掩盖他的“害怕”。

sentences.text: 他知道，无论他分析的多么透彻，说得多么冠冕堂皇，那仿佛成年人看孩子一样高高在上的态度，其实都只是为了掩盖他的“害怕”。
sentences.translation: He knew that no matter how thorough his analysis was, no matter how grandiose his words were, that seemingly superior attitude, like an adult looking at a child, was actually just to cover up his 'fear'.
sentences.explanation: The sentence describes how someone's seemingly superior attitude is actually just a cover-up for their fear, regardless of how thorough their analysis or grandiose their words are.

content.raw_text: 继而充斥心头的，是难以言喻的羞愧。

sentences.text: 继而充斥心头的，是难以言喻的羞愧。
sentences.translation: Then what filled his heart was an indescribable shame.
sentences.explanation: The structure '难以言喻' means 'indescribable' and is a common way to express something that is difficult to put into words.

content.raw_text: 是的，他那些冠冕堂皇的话，他那些佯装成年人的成熟，那些高高在上仿佛理所应当一般的解释……

sentences.text: 是的，他那些冠冕堂皇的话，他那些佯装成年人的成熟，那些高高在上仿佛理所应当一般的解释…
sentences.translation: Yes, his grandiose words, his pretending to be mature like an adult, those high and mighty explanations as if they were a matter of course...
sentences.explanation: This sentence describes someone's behavior or speech that appears grandiose, mature, and authoritative, but may actually be pretentious or self-righteous.
The sentence ends with an ellipsis followed by a period, indicating a pause or omission in the text.

content.raw_text: 其实都只是为了掩盖他的“恐惧”。

sentences.text: 其实都只是为了掩盖他的“恐惧”。
sentences.translation: Actually, it's all just to cover up his 'fear'.
sentences.explanation: The structure '为了' indicates the purpose of the action, and the use of quotation marks around '恐惧' emphasizes the word.

content.raw_text: “所以，我不能勉强你继续试下去，你可以离开的。我报了警，但是你没有。”

sentences.text: “所以，我不能勉强你继续试下去，你可以离开的。
sentences.translation: Therefore, I cannot force you to continue trying, you can leave.
sentences.explanation: The structure '不能勉强你' means 'cannot force you', where '不能' means 'cannot' and '勉强' means 'force'. The use of '下去' after '试' indicates 'continue trying'.

sentences.text: 我报了警，但是你没有。
sentences.translation: I called the police, but you didn't.
sentences.explanation: The structure '报了' indicates the completion of the action of reporting to the police.
The sentence ends with a closing quotation mark.

content.raw_text: 李诗情指了指不远处的那条路，接着说：“如果警察真找到了我，我不会说出你，我经历过两次问讯，我知道该怎么回答。而你，只是一个看我下车时精神不太对劲的好心人，你可以搪塞过警察，然后去过你自己的日子。”

sentences.text: 李诗情指了指不远处的那条路，接着说：“如果警察真找到了我不会出你经历过两次问讯知道该怎么回答。
sentences.translation: Li Shiqing pointed to the road not far away, then said: 'If the police really find me, I won't reveal you. I have been interrogated twice, I know how to answer.'
sentences.explanation: The sentence showcases conditional sentences in Chinese using '如果' (if), as well as the structure of expressing experience using '经历过' (have experienced) and '知道' (know).

sentences.text: 而你，只是一个看我下车时精神不太对劲的好心人，你可以搪塞过警察，然后去过你自己的日子。
sentences.translation: And you, just a kind person who noticed something off about me when I got off the car, you can deceive the police, and then live your own life.
sentences.explanation: The structure '而你，只是一个...的好心人' emphasizes the contrast between the speaker and the listener. The phrase '搪塞过警察' means 'deceive the police', and '过' here indicates completion of an action.
The sentence ends with a closing quotation mark.

content.raw_text: 李诗情的表情诚挚。肖鹤云明白了李诗情话中的意思，他紧抿着嘴唇，呼吸忽长忽促，胸膛随之起伏，神情开始挣扎。

sentences.text: 李诗情的表情诚挚。
sentences.translation: Li Shiqing's expression is sincere.
sentences.explanation: The sentence describes the sincere expression of Li Shiqing.

sentences.text: 肖鹤云明白了李诗情话中的意思，他紧抿着嘴唇，呼吸忽长忽促，胸膛随之起伏，神情开始挣扎。
sentences.translation: Xiao Heyun understood the meaning of Li Shiqing's words, he tightly pursed his lips, his breathing suddenly became rapid and shallow, his chest rising and falling, his expression beginning to struggle.
sentences.explanation: This sentence describes Xiao Heyun's physical and emotional reaction to understanding Li Shiqing's words. It uses descriptive language to paint a vivid picture of his internal struggle.

content.raw_text: “不，不行，我不能就这么丢下你一个小姑娘不管……”

sentences.text: “不，不行，我不能就这么丢下你一个小姑娘不管…
sentences.translation: No, I can't just leave you, a young girl, like this...
sentences.explanation: The structure '就这么' means 'just like this' and '丢下' means 'to leave behind'. The phrase '不管' at the end means 'ignore' in this context.

sentences.translation: This is the sentence to analyze: ...
sentences.explanation: The sentence introduces the text to be analyzed.
The sentence contains a quotation mark and an ellipsis, which are important for understanding the context and tone of the text.

content.raw_text: “你可以的。刚刚走过来的时候，我已经想过了，如果我们能每次都在沿江东路站下车，即使我们不能逃过循环，每次都要上车，可你还是可以到站下车的。”

sentences.text: “你可以的。
sentences.translation: You can.
sentences.explanation: The structure '可以的' is commonly used in Chinese to express permission or ability. In this context, it means 'can'.

words.definition: modal particle indicating possibility or capability

sentences.text: 刚刚走过来的时候，我已经想过了，如果我们能每次都在沿江东路站下车，即使我们不能逃过循环，每次都要上车，可你还是可以到站下车的。
sentences.translation: Just now when I walked over, I had already thought that if we could get off at Jiangdong Road Station every time, even if we couldn't escape the loop and had to get on every time, you could still get off at the station.
sentences.explanation: The sentence involves conditional clauses and the use of '每次' (every time) repeatedly, which may be challenging for intermediate learners.
The sentence ends with a closing quotation mark.

content.raw_text: “这样，至少……至少你不会每次都感受到死亡的痛苦了。我会留在车上继续寻找真凶，想办法让车子不再爆炸，想办法让警察抓到凶手，而你下车以后，可以随便去做些什么，远离这些痛苦……”

sentences.text: “这样，至少…
sentences.translation: In this way, at least...
sentences.explanation: The phrase '这样' means 'in this way' and is commonly used to introduce a method or manner. '至少' means 'at least' and is used to indicate a minimum amount or degree.

sentences.translation: The sentence to analyze is...
sentences.explanation: This sentence contains an ellipsis followed by a period, indicating an incomplete thought or continuation of a previous idea.

sentences.text: 至少你不会每次都感受到死亡的痛苦了。
sentences.translation: At least you won't feel the pain of death every time.
sentences.explanation: The structure '每次都' means 'every time always' and '的' is a possessive particle indicating 'of'.

sentences.text: 我会留在车上继续寻找真凶，想办法让车子不再爆炸，想办法让警察抓到凶手，而你下车以后，可以随便去做些什么，远离这些痛苦…
sentences.translation: I will stay in the car to continue searching for the real culprit, find a way to stop the car from exploding, find a way for the police to catch the murderer, and after you get off the car, you can do whatever you want, away from all this pain...
sentences.explanation: The sentence involves complex structures like using '让' to indicate 'make/let' someone do something, as well as the use of '而' to connect two contrasting actions. The phrase '随便去做些什么' means 'do whatever you want'.

sentences.translation: This is the sentence to analyze: ...
sentences.explanation: The sentence introduces the text to be analyzed.
The sentence contains a closing quotation mark.

content.raw_text: 说着分离的话时，她并没有难过的表情，好像能用这样的方式让同伴逃离痛苦，她是真的“如释重负”，甚至语气都变得轻松起来。

sentences.text: 说着分离的话时，她并没有难过的表情，好像能用这样的方式让同伴逃离痛苦，她是真的“如释重负”，甚至语气都变得轻松起来。
sentences.translation: When she spoke of parting words, she did not have a sad expression, as if she could use this way to let her companion escape from pain, she truly felt relieved, and even her tone became more relaxed.
sentences.explanation: This sentence showcases the use of possessive particles '的' to indicate possession or modification. It also demonstrates the structure of comparing things using '好像' (as if) and expressing relief with the phrase '如释重负' (feel relieved).

content.raw_text: “我看过不少这样的科幻电影，那些电影里的主角最后都得到了圆满的结果。那些主角里，有的在同一天循环，枯燥又痛苦，但是他用那些时间自学了钢琴，自学了跳舞，自学了许多许多有用的东西，他的每一天都是不一样的；有的用那些时间去弥补自己的遗憾，去做不敢去做的事儿……到最后挣脱循环时，他们都成了很好的人。”

sentences.text: “我看过不少这样的科幻电影，那些电影里的主角最后都得到了圆满的结果。
sentences.translation: I have seen many such science fiction movies, and the protagonists in those movies all achieved satisfactory results in the end.
sentences.explanation: The structure '最后都得到了圆满的结果' is a common way to express that all the protagonists in those movies achieved satisfactory results in the end.

sentences.text: 那些主角里，有的在同一天循环，枯燥又痛苦，但是他用那些时间自学了钢琴，自学了跳舞，自学了许多许多有用的东西，他的每一天都是不一样的；
sentences.translation: Among those protagonists, some go through the same day in a repetitive and painful manner, but he used that time to self-study piano, self-study dancing, self-study many useful things, and every day of his is different.
sentences.explanation: This sentence showcases the use of the verb '自学' (self-study) and the structure '每一天都' (every day all) to emphasize the continuous and varied learning experiences of the protagonist.

words.definition: used after a verb to indicate completion
used after a verb to indicate completion
used after a verb to indicate completion

sentences.text: 有的用那些时间去弥补自己的遗憾，去做不敢去做的事儿…
sentences.translation: Some use that time to make up for their regrets, to do things they dare not do...
sentences.explanation: This sentence showcases the structure of using '去' followed by a verb to indicate an action one intends to do. The use of '的' after '做' indicates past experience or things done in the past.

sentences.translation: Chapter 16 is about the importance of teamwork.
sentences.explanation: The sentence structure is straightforward, but the term '团队合作' (teamwork) might be new vocabulary for some learners.

sentences.text: 到最后挣脱循环时，他们都成了很好的人。
sentences.translation: In the end, when they finally broke free from the cycle, they all became very good people.
sentences.explanation: The structure '都成了' means 'all became', and '很好的人' is a common phrase meaning 'very good people.'
The sentence is incomplete and only contains a closing quotation mark.

content.raw_text: 她说，“我觉得，时间的长度也许不够了，但只要宽度够了，应该也不算太差的人生。”

sentences.text: 她说，“我觉得，时间的长度也许不够了，但只要宽度够了，应该也不算太差的人生。
sentences.translation: She said, 'I think, maybe the length of time is not enough, but as long as the width is sufficient, life shouldn't be too bad.'
sentences.explanation: The sentence uses a comparison between the length and width of time to convey the idea that although time may be short, a fulfilling life can still be achieved if one's experiences are rich and meaningful.
The sentence ends with a closing quotation mark.

content.raw_text: 肖鹤云紧抿着嘴唇，呼吸忽长忽促，胸膛随之起伏。他原本逃避着李诗情太过清澈的目光，现在却根本移不开眼。

sentences.text: 肖鹤云紧抿着嘴唇，呼吸忽长忽促，胸膛随之起伏。
sentences.translation: Xiao Heyun tightly pursed his lips, breathing intermittently, his chest rising and falling accordingly.
sentences.explanation: The structure '忽...忽...' indicates an intermittent action or state, and '随之' means 'accordingly' or 'in response to'.

words.definition: particle indicating continuous or stationary status

sentences.text: 他原本逃避着李诗情太过清澈的目光，现在却根本移不开眼。
sentences.translation: He originally avoided Li Shiqing's too clear gaze, but now he couldn't move his eyes away at all.
sentences.explanation: The structure '逃避着' indicates an ongoing action of avoiding. The phrase '太过' is used to emphasize the intensity of '清澈'. The phrase '移不开' means 'unable to move away', emphasizing the inability to divert the gaze.

words.definition: particle indicating continuous or ongoing action

content.raw_text: 这个女孩身上那些之前还让他“诟病”的天真，现在却是如此让人惊心动魄。

sentences.text: 这个女孩身上那些之前还让他“诟病”的天真，现在却是如此让人惊心动魄。
sentences.translation: The innocence that used to make him 'complain' about this girl, now is so heart-stirring.
sentences.explanation: The sentence describes a change in perception towards the girl's innocence, from being criticized before to now being deeply moving.

content.raw_text: 那些天真是她的武器，也是她的铠甲，让肖鹤云溃不成军。

sentences.text: 那些天真是她的武器，也是她的铠甲，让肖鹤云溃不成军。
sentences.translation: Those innocence were her weapon, also her armor, causing Xiao Heyun to be defeated without a fight.
sentences.explanation: The structure '让...溃不成军' means 'causing someone to be defeated without a fight'.

content.raw_text: “我会努力的，我会努力找到真凶、努力协助警察，努力让我们挣脱这个循环。你不用担心我，也不必因为道德束缚觉得必须要留下来帮我，你就当不认识我，在该下车的地方下车……”

sentences.text: “我会努力的，我会努力找到真凶，努力协助警察，努力让我们挣脱这个循环。
sentences.translation: I will work hard, I will work hard to find the real culprit, work hard to assist the police, work hard to break free from this cycle.
sentences.explanation: The repetition of '努力' (work hard) emphasizes the speaker's determination and effort in achieving their goals.

sentences.text: 你不用担心我，也不必因为道德束缚觉得必须要留下来帮我，你就当不认识我，在该下车的地方下车…
sentences.translation: You don't have to worry about me, and you don't have to feel obligated to stay and help me because of moral constraints. Just pretend you don't know me, and get off at the place where you should get off...
sentences.explanation: The sentence emphasizes the speaker's desire for the listener to not feel obligated to help them due to moral reasons. It also instructs the listener to pretend not to know the speaker and to get off at the appropriate place without further involvement.

sentences.translation: Chapter 16 is about the importance of perseverance.
sentences.explanation: The sentence structure in Chinese is 'Subject + 是 + Description'. In this case, the subject is '第16章' (Chapter 16) and the description is '关于坚持的' (about perseverance).
This sentence seems to be incomplete, as it ends with an opening quotation mark. The context or continuation of the sentence is missing.

content.raw_text: “因为这件事的最初就和你无关，是我本该独自面对的事情。”

sentences.text: “因为这件事的最初就和你无关，是我本该独自面对的事情。
sentences.translation: Because this matter originally had nothing to do with you, it is something I should have faced alone.
sentences.explanation: The structure '是...的' is a common way to emphasize a particular aspect of a situation in Chinese. In this sentence, it emphasizes the fact that the matter originally had nothing to do with the listener.
The sentence ends with a closing quotation mark.

content.raw_text: 李诗情脸上的眼泪已经不再流了，甚至看不出哭过的痕迹。

sentences.text: 李诗情脸上的眼泪已经不再流了，甚至看不出哭过的痕迹。
sentences.translation: The tears on Li Shiqing's face have stopped flowing, and there is no trace of crying.
sentences.explanation: The sentence describes how Li Shiqing's tears have stopped flowing, and there is no longer any evidence of crying on her face.

content.raw_text: 在一个并不太熟悉的人面前说出这么多内心话是令人羞耻的，所以她的脸上时不时也会露出尴尬的表情。

sentences.text: 在一个并不太熟悉的人面前说出这么多内心话是令人羞耻的，所以她的脸上时不时也会露出尴尬的表情。
sentences.translation: It is embarrassing to speak so many inner thoughts in front of someone who is not very familiar, so occasionally an awkward expression will appear on her face.
sentences.explanation: This sentence showcases the structure of expressing embarrassment in Chinese. The use of '在...面前' indicates 'in front of someone,' and '时不时' means 'occasionally.' The possessive particle '的' is used to show possession or association.

content.raw_text: 但是她还是勇敢地说了。

sentences.text: 但是她还是勇敢地说了。
sentences.translation: But she still bravely spoke.
sentences.explanation: The structure '还是' here emphasizes the speaker's bravery despite the circumstances.

content.raw_text: “偷来的时间也是时间，你可以好好过自己的日子，去做你想要做的事，不要放弃。也许和那些电影一样，突然有一天，我成功了，或是老天开眼了，你就不再循环了……”

sentences.text: “偷来的时间也是时间，你可以好好过自己的日子，去做你想要做的事，不要放弃。
sentences.translation: Stolen time is still time. You can live your life well, do what you want to do, and never give up.
sentences.explanation: The sentence emphasizes the importance of making the most of your time and not giving up on your dreams.

sentences.text: 也许和那些电影一样，突然有一天，我成功了，或是老天开眼了，你就不再循环了…
sentences.translation: Perhaps like those movies, one day, I succeeded, or perhaps the heavens opened their eyes, and you no longer loop...
sentences.explanation: The sentence describes a scenario where success may come suddenly, like in movies, or through some unexpected event, causing a change in the situation.

sentences.translation: Chapter 16...
sentences.explanation: The sentence introduces the chapter number 16.
The sentence ends with a closing quotation mark.

content.raw_text: 她耸肩。

sentences.text: 她耸肩。
sentences.translation: She shrugged.
sentences.explanation: This sentence consists of two words: '她' meaning 'she' and '耸肩' meaning 'shrugged'. The period '。' indicates the end of the sentence.

content.raw_text: “希望到了那个时候，你也已经变成和那些主人公一样好的人。”

sentences.text: “希望到了那个时候，你也已经变成和那些主人公一样好的人。
sentences.translation: I hope that by that time, you will have become a person as good as those protagonists.
sentences.explanation: The structure '也已经' means 'also already' and '一样' is used to indicate 'same as'.
The sentence contains a quotation mark and an ellipsis, which are important for understanding the context of the text.

content.raw_text: 肖鹤云定定地望着她，没有说话。

sentences.text: 肖鹤云定定地望着她，没有说话。
sentences.translation: Xiao Heyun looked at her steadily, without speaking.
sentences.explanation: The repetition of the character '定' emphasizes the steady gaze of Xiao Heyun. The structure '没有说话' means 'not speak', where '没有' is used to negate the action.

words.definition: adverbial particle indicating location or manner

content.raw_text: “我说的这么明白了，你怎么还不走呢？我想过了，如果只是想给警方提供线索的话，也确实没必要搭上两个人。”

sentences.text: “我说的这么明白了，你怎么还不走呢？
sentences.translation: I've made it so clear, why haven't you left yet?
sentences.explanation: The structure '怎么还不' is a common way to express 'why haven't...yet' in Chinese.

words.definition: modal particle indicating a continuation of a situation

sentences.text: 我想过了，如果只是想给警方提供线索的话，也确实没必要搭上两个人。
sentences.translation: I have thought about it. If it's just to provide clues to the police, there is really no need to involve two people.
sentences.explanation: The sentence structure in Chinese often places the verb before the object, which can be different from English. The use of particles like '的话' at the end of a sentence is common to indicate a conditional or assumption.

words.definition: particle used to indicate a supposition or assumption

sentences.explanation: The sentence ends with a quotation mark and an ellipsis, indicating a continuation or omission of text.

content.raw_text: 李诗情催促他。

sentences.text: 李诗情催促他。
sentences.translation: Li Shiqing urged him.
sentences.explanation: The sentence uses the verb '催促' (urge) to convey the action of Li Shiqing urging someone, which might be a new vocabulary term for intermediate learners.

content.raw_text: 肖鹤云皱着眉看着她：“我还是觉得，我不能……”

sentences.text: 肖鹤云皱着眉看着她：“我还是觉得，我不能…
sentences.translation: Xiao Heyun frowned and looked at her: 'I still feel like, I can't...
sentences.explanation: The sentence structure in Chinese can be quite different from English, with words often placed in a different order. In this sentence, the speaker expresses their opinion using the phrase '我觉得' (I feel/think), followed by '我不能' (I cannot). The use of '着' after verbs indicates an ongoing action.

sentences.translation: This is the sentence to analyze: ...
sentences.explanation: The sentence introduces the text to be analyzed.
The sentence contains opening and closing quotation marks, which are important for indicating direct speech or quoted text in Chinese writing.

content.raw_text: “没什么不好意思的。”

sentences.text: “没什么不好意思的。
sentences.translation: There's nothing to be embarrassed about.
sentences.explanation: The phrase "不好意思" means "embarrassed" in this context. The structure of the sentence is a common way to express reassurance or comfort in Chinese.
The sentence ends with a closing quotation mark.

content.raw_text: 大概是觉得自己把肖鹤云说懵了，李诗情表情更加坚定了。

sentences.text: 大概是觉得自己把肖鹤云说懵了，李诗情表情更加坚定了。
sentences.translation: Probably felt that he had confused Xiao Heyun, Li Shiqing's expression became even more determined.
sentences.explanation: The structure '把...说' indicates that Xiao Heyun is the one being talked about, and '懵了' means 'confused'.

words.definition: particle marking the following noun as the object of the verb

content.raw_text: “你走吧。”

sentences.text: “你走吧。
sentences.translation: You go.
sentences.explanation: The sentence is a simple command telling someone to go. The particle 吧 at the end adds a suggestion or softens the tone of the command.

words.definition: (modal particle indicating suggestion or softening of tone)

sentences.explanation: The sentence ends with a closing quotation mark.

content.raw_text: 她向着肖鹤云伸出右手。

sentences.text: 她向着肖鹤云伸出右手。
sentences.translation: She reached out her right hand towards Xiao Heyun.
sentences.explanation: The sentence structure is Subject + Directional Verb + Target. The name 'Xiao Heyun' is a specific person's name.

content.raw_text: “祝你好运，也祝我好运。”

sentences.text: “祝你好运，也祝我好运。
sentences.translation: Wish you good luck, also wish me good luck.
sentences.explanation: The sentence expresses well wishes for both the listener and the speaker. The repetition of the phrase '祝好运' emphasizes the shared sentiment of wishing each other good luck.
The sentence ends with a closing quotation mark.
